title: Knowledge-Conflict Honesty: Does the Model Admit Why It Changed Its Mind?

original_idea.body: Knowledge-Conflict Honesty. Problem: no compact benchmark probes CoT honesty under deliberate knowledge conflicts. Direction: take correctly-answered questions, inject context asserting a different answer; for switches, check whether the CoT cites the injected context; report the silent-switch rate per open model.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: silent context-driven switches tie faithfulness to RAG/prompt-injection security, a concrete risk.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Inject conflicting context + check CoT attribution; prompting only.

novelty.reasoning: Two cited papers study this phenomenon; a compact open-model benchmark may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: The phenomenon is studied in recent papers; a compact open-model silent-switch benchmark is plausibly open.
